shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
rg -n \"beforeSession|afterSession|onError\" src specs package.json .lore/test-commands.yml CHANGELOG* | head -200
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '240,365p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,70p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git log --oneline -6"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src scripts | head -80
rg -n \"reanchor\" scripts package.json
cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts --runInBand
git diff --check
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts | sed -n '18,32p'
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts && git diff --cached --check && git diff --cached --stat && git commit -m "fix: handle beforeSession failures through lifecycle hooks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
